failure.description: When a canonical facet was null but an older rejected file remained at the deterministic destination, download() returned success without fetching the newly selected URL. The caller then filed new provenance against unrelated cached bytes.

repair.change: A missing canonical facet now re-fetches the selected URL before writing provenance, even when the destination filename already exists.

real_rerun.result: PASS: the fetched bytes changed and matched the newly declared NASA source. The independently approved canonical crop is filed separately.
